payload.text: Holding until richhickson merges https://github.com/richhickson/claudecodeusage/pull/18 (opened 2026-11-17 by hv's hand, head 52b846a: Claude Usage names an item's account again when its login changes, and keeps history per account) and ships it in a release: then hv updates Claude Usage from that release, and watch-out 2 (stale names after a switch) is spent. Check the PR's state at each pickup (gh pr view 18 -R richhickson/claudecodeusage --json state).
